_readme: Referral and affiliate link slots. PLACEHOLDERS: leave url empty until you have a real, approved referral URL. Entries with an empty url are not rendered anywhere, so no fake links go live. Once filled in, links are output with rel="sponsored noopener" and an 'Affiliate link' label. Edit this file on main only; the build picks it up.
